name: @undefineds.co/xpod-desktop
description: Xpod desktop tray shell: window lifecycle, system tray and external browser hand-off for the local settings dashboard.

scripts.smoke: bun run build && XPOD_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1 electron dist/main.js
scripts.build:runtime: cd .. && bun run build && node scripts/build-bun-single.js --output=desktop/runtime/xpod
scripts.dist: bun run build:runtime && bun run build && electron-builder --mac
